name: Nystrom 4
description: Explicit 4 step Nystrom method. The family integrates across two steps rather than one, which buys an order at the cost of a parasitic root sitting on the unit circle.

references.authors: Hairer, E., Noersett, S. P., & Wanner, G.
references.title: Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I: Nonstiff Problems
references.source: Springer Series in Computational Mathematics, Vol. 8, 2nd edition
